title: Battle of Vasilika
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Vasilika", at revision 1370592210, opens: "The Battle of Vasilika was fought between Greek revolutionaries and the Ottoman Empire during the Greek War of Independence." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q3403037, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1821 battle during the Greek War of Independence". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
